title: Social Biases in Automatic Evaluation Metrics for NLG
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and quantifying social biases (specifically gender bias) in NLG evaluation metrics. While social biases are an ethical concern for fairness, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark "faith," "morals," or "ethics" as explicit domains or components. The "Ethics Statement" frames social bias as an ethical problem for text quality, rather than a direct object of faith/ethics evaluation.
